Early Monday gains, supported by news of renewed peace talks between Washington and Tehran that drove Brent crude price sharply lower and boosted risk sentiment, were reversed in less than an hour, pushing the  to its lowest level in a month.  The benchmark has been stuck near the 7500-point mark, a level it first surpassed in mid-May, for more than six weeks now.
